title: Modern reference dataset: the 118 IUPAC-recognized chemical elements
purpose: Authoritative modern values for reconciliation against the 1926 Walter Russell chart (R15). Published with the chart edition as the modern side of the reconciliation.

conventions.atomic_weight: CIAAW Standard Atomic Weights 2024, verbatim strings: single values with (uncertainty in last digits), intervals as [a, b]. Elements without a standard atomic weight carry type "mass_number": the bracketed NUBASE2020 mass number of the most stable isotope(s) — this is NOT an atomic weight.
conventions.melting_point_c: Normal melting point tm at 101.325 kPa in °C on ITS-90, per CRC 97th ed.; value null = no experimentally determined value exists (see per-record note). Allotrope choices noted per record.
conventions.discovery: Year and credited discoverer(s). For the 84 elements with CIAAW element pages, CIAAW’s historical note is the source. For the rest: the primary discovery announcement (DOI) or the IUPAC/IUPAP TWG/JWP credit-assignment reports; CRC Sec. 4 "The Elements" is cited where the primary paper (1890s Comptes Rendus) has no stable retrievable copy (gallica.bnf.fr was unreachable on the retrieval date), with the primary bibliographic reference given in the note.
conventions.naming: For elements 104–118 only: year the IUPAC-approved name was adopted, per the IUPAC naming recommendations published in Pure and Applied Chemistry.
conventions.aliases_1926: Orthography/nomenclature variants current around 1926, for joining against the Russell chart. Alias entries without a per-record CIAAW citation are standard nomenclature history and should be re-verified against the 1926 scans before publication [INFERENCE].
